takeaway: A quieter day: OpenMausBot returned to its launch pace (+1,999 stars) and Cloudflare's security-audit skill held above 2,300 a day, while last week's leaders cooled. Tomorrow scores the first forecast built mostly on the radar's own API measurements.

findings.heading: OpenMausBot rebounds
findings.text: milind-soni/OpenMausBot, a local-first chat app where each bot is an agent with its own cloud computer, went from 13,835 to 15,834 stars in a day, after 1,549 and 493.

findings.heading: Cloudflare's security skill holds its pace
findings.text: cloudflare/security-audit-skill gained 2,300 stars (to 64,444), its second day above 2,300.

findings.heading: Last week's leaders cool
findings.text: vercel-labs/agent-desktop gained 992 stars (after 1,595) and NVIDIA/auto-ontology 1,478 (after 2,127); t3code passed 50,000.

findings.heading: Forecasts steady
findings.text: The Oct 31 ranking scored a rank correlation of 0.58 and got 53% of its top 15 right across 103 apps; random picks would get about 15%.

caveats: No company figure was recorded today: the three candidates were a repeat, a stale figure and a feature count.
Today's daily trending page was mostly non-AI; measured growth came from the API.
Hugging Face and Hacker News remain unreachable from the cloud environment.
